sentences.text: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navneet Kumar For the Petitioner : Mr. Ashok Kumar Sinha,
Advocate For the State : Mr. Vijoy Kumar Sinha, A.P.P. 02/11.07.2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. representing the State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it is matrimonial dispute between the parties including the petitioner- husband and the opposite party no.2-wife for the offence punishable under Section 506, 498A/34 IPC and section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and petitioner is ready to resolve the dispute amicably between the parties.
Issue notice upon the opposite party no.2 under registered cover with A/D as well as through ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within 10 days.

In the meantime, under the facts and circumstances of the case, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case No. 1050 of 2023 pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Koderma subject to the condition that petitioner shall cooperate in the investigation and shall appear before the Investigating Officer / court concerned as and when required, failing which, the learned court below shall take appropriate steps for cancellation of the interim relief as per the provision of law.

(Navneet Kumar, J.) A.Mohanty Yogendra Sharma vs The State Of Jharkhand on 11 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185714724/
